head: codex/5332-v0918-wp15-unity-ilpp-exec-prep
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Classify and fix Unity ILPP GetDomainName loop
body:
Closes #5332

Diagnoses the Unity 6000.5.1f1 ILPP retry loop as restricted-lane getdomainname denial, adds a fail-closed host-capability preflight and progress-aware classifier, and introduces a controlled evidence-rich diagnostic matrix with focused regression coverage.

Focused proof passes for the wrapper, matrix, selector, and contract guardrails. An operator-approved host run crossed ILPP and completed the existing staged shell-plus-flagship validator with 43 prefab instances, 79 game objects, 4 cameras, and 7 lights. Licensed Unity assets and generated Library state remain on FastWork and are not committed.

Exact-head review passed with no actionable findings. This PR proves the tooling diagnosis and staged validator path; it does not claim investor-ready shell layout, runtime integration, rendering polish, or complete demo readiness.
